newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan group wins $300 mln Argentina power project.
newsitem.headline: Japan group wins $300 mln Argentina power project.

text.p: Nichimen Corp said on Monday that it and two other Japanese companies had won a $300-million contract from AES Corp of the United States to build a thermal power plant in Argentina.

Nichimen, together with Mitsubishi Corp and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd, will build a combined-cycle 830,000-kilowatt power plant in Parana, northwest of Buenos Aires, by 1999, a Nichimen spokesman said.
"We have reached a preliminary agreement with AES on the project," he said.
"The official signing will be carried out by the end of this year after details of the financing for the project have been sorted out," he added.
The power plant will run on crude and fuel oil, he added.
